---
title: "Prior sensitivity of the cross-site invariance comparison"
---

The multigroup models in `02_fit_irt.qmd` are MAP fits under a slope prior of
`a1 ~ N(1, 0.3)`, the shared LEVANTE prior applied across all tasks. Because that
prior shrinks discriminations toward equality, it is doing part of the work in
selecting among invariance models. This script refits the same five models over a
range of slope priors so the sensitivity can be reported.

Two things to note.

First, the reported `logLik` is the unpenalized likelihood evaluated at the
penalized optimum, and the number of prior terms differs across models (the
configural model applies the slope prior separately in each group). At tight
priors this makes `logLik` non-monotonic in model nesting, which is expected for
MAP fits rather than a convergence failure. `logPost` is the quantity actually
being maximized.

Second, `rlevante:::remove_no_var_items_bygroup` currently tests `n_cat < 0`,
which `n_distinct()` can never satisfy, so the filter is a no-op. The published
models were fit when it tested `n_cat < 2`. The patched version below is required
to reproduce them; without it the overlap set grows from 54 to 81 item instances.

```{r}
library(glue)
library(here)
library(mirt)
library(rlang)
library(rlevante)
library(tidyverse)

# vendored from levante-pilots 02_score_data/02_fit_irt/irt_helpers.R, which moved
# into the levantemodels package in the July 2026 reorg; the copy here keeps this
# script runnable against the model specification the published fits used.
source(here("helper/irt_helpers.R"))

invariances <- list(
  configural = "",
  metric     = c("slopes"),
  scalar     = c("free_means", "free_var", "intercepts", "slopes")
)

# patched copy of rlevante:::remove_no_var_items_bygroup (see note above)
remove_no_var_items_bygroup_fixed <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(item_inst, group) |>
    mutate(n_cat = n_distinct(correct)) |>
    group_by(item_inst) |>
    mutate(low_cat = any(n_cat < 2)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(!low_cat) |>
    select(-n_cat, -low_cat)
}
```

```{r}
# rebuild the overlap-item data exactly as fit_task_models_multigroup does
trials <- read_rds(here("data/task_data_nested.rds")) |>
  filter(item_task == "mrot") |>
  unnest(data) |>
  rename(group = dataset) |>
  mutate(item_uid = as.character(item_uid)) |>
  filter(!is.na(correct))

df_overlap <- trials |>
  rlevante:::dedupe_items() |>
  rlevante:::remove_no_var_items() |>
  rlevante:::remove_nonshared_items() |>
  remove_no_var_items_bygroup_fixed()

data_wide <- df_overlap |> rlevante:::to_mirt_shape_grouped()
data_prepped <- data_wide |> select(-group)
guess <- df_overlap |> distinct(item_inst, chance) |> pull(chance)

stopifnot(ncol(data_prepped) == 54, sum(!is.na(data_prepped)) == 49603)
```

```{r}
models_multigroup <- tribble(
  ~itemtype, ~invariance,
      "2PL", "configural",
      "2PL", "metric",
      "2PL", "scalar",
    "Rasch", "configural",
    "Rasch", "scalar",
)

fit_one <- function(itemtype, invariance, priors) {
  model_str <- generate_model_str_numeric(df_overlap, data_prepped, itemtype, 1, priors)
  mod <- multipleGroup(
    data = data_prepped,
    itemtype = itemtype,
    model = mirt.model(model_str),
    group = data_wide$group,
    invariance = invariances[[invariance]],
    guess = guess,
    verbose = FALSE,
    TOL = 1e-5,
    technical = list(NCYCLES = 30000)
  )
  slopes <- mod2values(mod) |> as_tibble() |> filter(name == "a1", item != "GROUP")
  tibble(itemtype = itemtype, invariance = invariance,
         n_pars = extract.mirt(mod, "nestpars"),
         logLik = mod@Fit$logLik, logPrior = mod@Fit$logPrior,
         logPost = mod@Fit$logLik + mod@Fit$logPrior,
         AIC = mod@Fit$AIC, BIC = mod@Fit$BIC,
         converged = extract.mirt(mod, "converged"),
         a_median = median(slopes$value), a_max = max(slopes$value))
}

# slope prior SDs to sweep over; NA means no prior at all
prior_sds <- c(0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, NA)

prior_sensitivity <- prior_sds |>
  map(\(s) {
    priors <- if (is.na(s)) NULL else list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, s))
    models_multigroup |>
      pmap(\(itemtype, invariance) fit_one(itemtype, invariance, priors)) |>
      list_rbind() |>
      mutate(prior_sd = s, .before = everything())
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(d_BIC = BIC - min(BIC), .by = prior_sd)

write_rds(prior_sensitivity, here("models/mrot_prior_sensitivity.rds"), compress = "gz")
prior_sensitivity
```
